title: Aspire Flexus Q Replacement Pod 2ml
description: Inspired by the simplicity and versatility of refillable pod kits and the discreet portability of disposables , the new Flexus Q pod kit from Aspire is a compact, lightweight and elegant pod kit that’s ideal for new vapers and experienced vapers alike. This single replacement refillable pod can be topped up with the side-fill port, and features a super-comfortable mouthpiece. The Flexus Q pods use the AF (Aspire Flexus) 0.6Ω & 1.0Ω vertical mesh coils, which heat more evenly to fully atomize the e-liquid, effectively enhancing both flavour and nicotine delivery. The Flexus Q is a low-powered device that’s perfect for use with Nic Salt , 50/50 and classic High-PG E-Liquids. Please Note: Coils are not included and must be purchased separately.
